method: Move Fast: high engineering velocity, pragmatic execution over academic perfection, and bias for shipping
Focus on Long-Term Impact: building tools and architectures that scale to billions of daily active users
Be Direct and Respectful: crisp, transparent communication with high accountability for shipped software

entry-level: Speed and correctness: writing bug-free code quickly under time constraints
Hands-on full-stack or systems fundamentals with rapid debugging instincts
Proactive collaboration and enthusiasm for high-impact social product features
mid-level: End-to-end execution on product features from database schema to client UI
Managing high-concurrency real-time feeds, fan-out architectures, and GraphQL APIs
Balancing rapid delivery with performance telemetry and automated regression testing
senior: Designing high-throughput asynchronous infrastructure (Tao/Memcached graph caching, RocksDB, LogDevice)
Cross-functional alignment across product, data science, infrastructure, and privacy engineering
Driving org-wide reliability through load testing, shadow traffic, and fast rollback mechanisms
staff-plus: Strategic direction for multi-product infrastructure supporting billions of users
Pioneering company-wide architectural shifts (e.g. unified graph platforms, AI infrastructure scale)
Unifying conflicting team priorities into coherent platforms with massive leverage

swe: Fast API design, GraphQL / REST contracts, efficient graph queries, and distributed cache invalidation
React/Web performance (hydration, bundle size) or iOS/Android native performance (memory, battery)
ml-data: Ranking & Recommendation engines, real-time CTR prediction, embeddings caching, PyTorch scaling
sre-infra: Edge caching, global load balancing, custom hardware efficiency, and automated remediation
pm-design: A/B testing experimentation discipline, growth funnels, network effects, and intuitive UI craftsmanship
em-lead: Unblocking engineers, setting high execution velocity, and managing performance with radical candor
